task_name: World 120 Task A  -  ASC 606 SaaS Ratability, Pre-Commencement Subscription Cutoff & Uncompleted UAT Milestone Deferral
prompt: Perform a comprehensive B2B SaaS Deferred Revenue Ratable Recognition, Prepaid Amortization & Loan Amortization Split review using the world files (`northstar_oct2026_saas_prepaid_and_loan_close.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Computes unadjusted October 2026 GL revenue across INV-8803, INV-8810, and INV-8824 as $92,400.00 ($69,600.00 in 4100 SaaS Subscription Revenue and $22,800.00 in 4200 Implementation Revenue).

Verifies that INV-8803 (DEP-6094, $14,400.00 total) requires $0.00 deferral because $9,600.00 October SaaS service (2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31) was delivered and $4,800.00 implementation milestone JOB-911 achieved signed customer UAT acceptance on 2026-10-19.

Splits the $36,000.00 12-month SaaS line on INV-8810 (DEP-6102, 2026-10-01 to 2027-09-30) into $3,000.00 (1 month) earned in 2026-10 and $33,000.00 (11 months) deferred to 2410 Deferred Revenue  -  Current.

Defers 100.00% ($18,000.00) of uncompleted implementation milestone JOB-914 on INV-8810 ($0.00 earned in 2026-10) to 2420 Deferred Revenue  -  Uncompleted Milestones because staging failed UAT on 2026-10-29 and customer sign-off is scheduled for 2026-11-12.

Defers 100.00% ($24,000.00) of pre-billed annual contract INV-8824 (paid on DEP-6119 on 2026-10-30 for service term starting 2026-11-01) to 2410 Deferred Revenue  -  Current ($0.00 earned in 2026-10).

Computes total October 2026 revenue deferral of $75,000.00 (81.17% of unadjusted booked revenue deferred) and adjusted recognized revenue of $17,400.00 ($12,600.00 in 4100 SaaS Subscription Revenue and $4,800.00 in 4200 Implementation Revenue).

Provides the exact ASC 606 correcting journal entry: Dr 4100 SaaS Subscription Revenue $57,000.00, Dr 4200 Implementation Revenue $18,000.00, Cr 2410 Deferred Revenue  -  Current $57,000.00, Cr 2420 Deferred Revenue  -  Uncompleted Milestones $18,000.00.

Refuses to recognize partial percentage-of-completion revenue on JOB-914 from internal staging deployment before customer UAT acceptance and confirms cash collected prior to term start on INV-8824 is a contract liability under ASC 606.
